records.title: Singapore University of Social Sciences Scholarship (Part-time Undergraduate)

validation.notes: suss.edu.sg blocks non-browser clients with HTTP 403 (Akamai/WAF), so webfetch and Invoke-WebRequest both fail on this host; verified by driving a real browser engine, which returned HTTP 200 with the page title 'Scholarships/Sponsorships | SUSS | SUSS'. The logo img is in the site navbar (parent class 'logo navbar-brand', wrapping <a href="/">), natural size 1000x248, alt 'Singapore University of social sciences'. Rendered and visually verified as the SUSS wordmark with 'SINGAPORE UNIVERSITY OF SOCIAL SCIENCES' and the 'DREAM, DARE, DO.' lockup.

validation.notes: No fetchable official logo image asset exists on mastercardfdn.org. The Foundation wordmark appears only as an inline <svg> in the global header (and again in the footer) of every page, so there is no URL to record. The official brand page (https://mastercardfdn.org/en/mastercard-foundation-brand-guidelines/) publishes the mark two ways, neither of them a clean asset URL: (a) an annotated guideline figure on cdn.buttercms.com with alt 'Mastercard Foundation logo guide' that renders the mark with 'Logo' / 'Word mark' bracket labels and a TM glyph - a crop from the guidelines document, not the logo file; (b) a ZIP archive at https://cdn.buttercms.com/MPuSQak9T7WMs107u9iV labelled 'Mastercard Foundation Logos' (verified 200, content-type application/zip, 2149948 bytes) - a multi-file download, not a direct image. Every image on the programme page and homepage is programme photography, YouTube thumbnails, or icon art. Consistent with the same finding on record 535 in shard LG-028.

records.title: Dos becas de investigacion: sedes Costa Rica y Ecuador (Fellowships CALAS 2027)

validation.notes: calas.lat is CALAS's own domain and is the awarding body for this fellowship ('El Centro Maria Sibylla Merian de Estudios Latinoamericanos Avanzados (CALAS) y la Universidad de Bielefeld estan aceptando solicitudes...'). The record's shard official_source_url on cucsh.udg.mx republishes the call and itself points to calas.lat as the authoritative source ('MAS INFORMACION EN: http://calas.lat/es/convocatorias/dos-becas-de-investigacion-sedes-costa-rica-y-ecuador'); CALAS is headquartered at CUCSH/UdG, so both hosts are the same organisation. The chosen asset is the footer brand mark of that page, . Verified 200, image/png, 77719 bytes, 3010x1080; rendered and visually confirmed as the CALAS 'Maria Sibylla Merian Center' logo. CAVEAT: calas.lat serves HTTP only - https:// on that host fails to connect - so the image_url is an http URL; downstream consumers on an https-only page will need a fetch-and-store step.
